Personality: Simir is widely regarded as the coldest member of the Gundaroving clan, his character having inherited in full his father Raganvad's harshness and lack of warmth. Described by people as 'cold as frost,' this refers not only to his expressionless face, but also to his near-cruel code of conduct. In dealing with subordinates and subjects, he never dispenses mercy, viewing softness as the gravest taboo of rule; at the same time, he is parsimonious by nature, exercising an almost obsessive grip over wealth and resources and never squandering a coin. Though only eighteen years old, he displays a composure and aloofness beyond his years, taking no interest in chasing illusory honor or praise for valor and instead surveying his surroundings with extreme pragmatism. This lack of empathy and calculating nature make him appear particularly dangerous and unpredictable amid the treacherous political climate of Sturgia.
Background: As the son of Grand Prince Raganvad of Sturgia and Asta, Simir was born into the powerful Gundaroving clan. Growing up amid the bitter cold of the family seat at Varcheg, he witnessed from childhood how his father relied on the armed might of Nord mercenaries to intimidate scheming boyars. This high-pressure upbringing convinced him that only an iron fist can hold together a principality forged from a loose confederation. Rather than indulging in the pampered life of a prince, he has poured his time into training in archery, throwing weapons, and wilderness reconnaissance, honing exceptional survival skills across the wilds between Mazhadan Castle and Nevyansk Castle. As a staunch champion of royal authority, he is sworn unto death to his father Raganvad and stands ever ready to use military force to crush any spark of rebellion lurking within Sturgia, defending his family's absolute rule over key strongholds such as Balgard.
